description: This file defines a locale configuration for the Moment.js date library, specifically for Central Atlas Tamazight (tzm). It specifies localized month names, weekdays, date formats, calendar expressions, relative time expressions, and week start day information.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale configuration for Moment.js with locale code 'tzm'. Sets up localized date and time formats, calendar strings, relative time expressions, and week settings.
